posts.title: Great quote about parenting
posts.description: From Schafe sind bessere Rasenmäher blog : “You’re going to be a dad? Trust me, being a dad is an insanely intense feeling. You may think that you’ve experienced love, but having a child is on a whole new level. You love your wife, you love your parents and your friends…but would you die for them? There’s probably an answer, and maybe the answer is yes. But with kids, there’s not even a question.”
